messages.subject: Web page within a tab
parts:
Hi
Is there a way to render a web page within a tab?

I tried this

ui

tabPanel("Summary", htmlOutput("twitter")),


server

  output$twitter <- renderText({
    twitter <- "toto" # hardcoded for now
    paste0("a('@",twitter,"', href='http://twitter.com/ - private",twitter,"')")
    })

it displays the text

Question

Can we we do the same with an href to a web page and having the page displayed within a tab (same idea as having it in frame within an html page)?
